meta.parties: Menik Ettana Et Al. v. Allis Appu

rules.statement: A transfer by a husband to his wife is not for valuable consideration under the Matrimonial Rights Ordinance, 1876.
rules.supporting_quote: "By the Ordinance of 1876 all movable property to which a married woman is entitled during her marriage vests absolutely in her husband, so that presumably the money handed by the plaintiff to her husband Telenis as the consideration for the transfer was his own money. In other words, the transfer to her was not for valuable consideration."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance No.15 of 1876, s. 19
